ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture Tea（中世日本 - 文化・茶）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo-RimWorld
ModMetaData.description:
A standalone AMJ Culture-family child Mod for historical everyday tea and toasted-grain-flour kogashi-yu, as non-drug recreational drinks. Does not require AMJ Culture. Tea is self-contained; AMJ Grains barley is an optional ingredient for kogashi-yu. Early development build: provisional values and Vanilla graphics; no game-run acceptance yet.
AMJ Culture系列の単独導入可能な子Mod。中世日本の日常の茶と、米・大麦の炒り粉を湯で溶いたこがし湯を追加する。Culture本体は必須ではない。非ドラッグの軽い娯楽飲料。Grainsの大麦は任意連携。開発中につき数値・画像・実機動作は未確定。
